title: How to grow fresh air | Kamal Meattle
summary: Researcher Kamal Meattle describes how an arrangement of three common houseplants placed in specific spots can measurably clean the air in a home or office. It is a short TED talk based on his work in a plant-filled building.
why: HN commenters cite it in threads about indoor air quality, CO2 and houseplants as a cheap, low-tech approach.

quote.text: There is also a Ted talk about taking this to an extreme, which does seem to anecdotally work
